title: Demeo's Apple Vision Pro Update: Mixed Reality & Foveated Rendering
text: Ready to experience ‘ Demeo ‘ like never before? The popular virtual tabletop RPG ‘Demeo’ is getting a major upgrade, boasting stunning visual improvements and mixed reality support on Apple Vision Pro. Discover how these enhancements transform the gameplay and deliver a more immersive experience, and learn what the future holds for this beloved VR title. “`html ‘Demeo’ Levels Up: Visual Overhaul, Mixed Reality on Apple Vision Pro April 16, 2025 A Virtual Tabletop Transformed The popular virtual tabletop RPG, ‘Demeo,’ has received a meaningful upgrade, enhancing its visual fidelity and expanding its immersive capabilities. The update brings mixed reality support and eye-tracked foveated rendering to Apple Vision Pro, alongside improvements across all platforms. ‘Demeo’: A Quick Overview Genre: Virtual tabletop turn-based RPG Players: Up to four Platforms: VR: Meta Quest, PlayStation VR2, Pico, PC VR, Apple Vision Pro Flatscreen: PC, PlayStation 5, iPad, Mac Features: Crossplay support between all platforms, mixed reality option on Quest and Pico Technological Advancements Resolution Games invested 10 months in upgrading the game’s underlying technology. Key changes include: Engine Upgrade: Transition to Unity 6 Rendering Pipeline: Switch to Unity’s Universal Render Pipeline (URP) These changes, while largely unseen, provide tangible benefits. Resolution Games reports that players can expect faster loading times, improved performance and higher fidelity. Before (left) and After (right) A Sharper, More Detailed World The visual overhaul extends to all platforms, featuring: Upgraded metallic materials Improved water shader Increased environmental props Enhanced environmental lighting Apple Vision Pro: A New Level of Immersion Apple Vision Pro users will experience the most significant visual leap. The integration of Unity 6 and URP enables eye-tracked foveated rendering. This technology dramatically increases resolution in the user’s focal point. Early testing indicates a substantial improvement in visual clarity. The game’s sharpness now aligns more closely with the native visionOS environment. Eye-tracked foveated rendering is also active on Quest Pro and slated for Google’s upcoming Android XR platform. Before (left) and After (right) Mixed Reality Comes to Vision Pro The update introduces mixed reality support to Apple Vision Pro. Previously, the visionOS version offered only fully immersive VR or 2D windowed modes. Now, users can enable passthrough in immersive mode, mirroring the mixed reality experience already available on Quest and Pico. Where to Buy ‘Demeo’ is available for $40 on: App Store Meta Horizon Store steam Epic Games PlayStation Store Pico Store The App Store version employs Apple’s universal purchase system, granting access across Apple Vision, iPad, and Mac with a single purchase. what’s Next? The ‘Demeo’ series will expand with Demeo x Dungeons & Dragons: Battlemarked , an officially licensed title announced earlier this year. This crossover promises to blend ‘Demeo’s’ virtual tabletop mechanics with the rich lore of dungeons & Dragons.
